To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
cloud computing and SDNs can work together to provide an effective defense against DDoS attack.

1) SDN can help enterprises to defend DDoS attacks by providing flexible control and programmable data plane; 2) a new DDoS attack detection architecture is needed to enable SDN-based DDoS defense; and 3) a new DDP mitigation architecture is needed to provide fast reaction to detected DDoS attacks.
SDN can actually help enterprises mitigate DDoS attacks, if the defense architecture can be designed properly.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the security implications of the new enterprise network architecture that integrates cloud computing and SDNs.
the security issues of the emerging cloud computing and SDNs.
the security issues in an enterprise network that adopts both SDN and cloud technologies.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
SDN technology, when integrated with cloud computing in an enterprise network, can help enterprises defend against DDo-S attacks.
SDN is a powerful and promising technology to enhance the DDoS attack protection in the era of cloud computing.
the marriage of the two technologies can be a win-win for both enterprises and cloud providers.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the marriage of cloud and SDN is not a threat to network security, but rather a chance to enhance network security.
SDN can actually improve the network's security if properly designed.
the marriage of cloud and SDN can be beneficial for enterprises to improve the security of the enterprise network.
The main takeaway from our work is that
SDN can actually help to improve the DDoS attack detection accuracy and reduce the attack reaction time, and hence improve the overall network performance in terms of throughput and delay.
SDN technology has great potential to improve the DDoS defense capability in the cloud computing era, if it is properly designed.
SDN is a good technology that can be utilized for better DDoS attack protection.
